test_title: PYST 58: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains as error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

We never expected __most__ from her.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. much .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"most"** in the sentence is incorrect in context. The intention of the sentence is to express a low level of expectation, which requires the word **"much."**
 
• **"Much"** is used to describe an uncountable amount, which fits the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• Other options like **"little,"** **"more,"** and **"many"** do not fit grammatically or contextually in this case.

Correct sentence: *We never expected much from her.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of "much":** 

 
 
• **Context:** "Much" is used to describe an uncountable quantity or degree, often in negative sentences, questions, or with comparatives.
 
• **Example:** "We don’t have much time to complete this task."
 
 
 
• **Contrast with "many":** 

 
 
• **Context:** "Many" is used to describe countable quantities and is not suitable here.
 
• **Example:** "She has many books on her shelf."
